claims.quote: The chair, like the music, was worked by machinery, and it rolled her to the other side of the room
claims.description: Personal chairs and music are powered by automated machinery.

claims.quote: the round plate that she held in her hands began to glow
claims.description: A handheld plate shows live two-way video of distant people.

claims.quote: The air-ship barely takes two days to fly between me and you.
claims.description: Airships cross the globe in about two days.

claims.quote: She would summon a car and it would fly with her down the tunnel until it reached the lift that communicated with the air-ship station
claims.description: Automated cars carry passengers through underground tunnels to airship stations.

claims.quote: There was the button that produced literature.
claims.description: A machine on demand produces books and other literature.

claims.quote: Immediately an enormous apparatus fell on to her out of the ceiling, a thermometer was automatically inserted between her lips, a stethoscope was automatically laid upon her heart.
claims.description: Ceiling-mounted machines automatically diagnose and treat patients in their rooms.

claims.quote: Each infant was examined at birth, and all who promised undue strength were destroyed.
claims.description: Newborns are screened at birth and those judged too strong are killed.

claims.quote: The surface of the earth is only dust and mud, no life remains on it, and you would need a respirator, or the cold of the outer air would kill you.
claims.description: The Earth's surface is lifeless dust, and people need respirators to survive outside.

claims.quote: Homelessness means death. The victim is exposed to the air, which kills him.
claims.description: Exile from the underground city exposes a person to open air, which kills them.

claims.quote: Men seldom moved their bodies; all unrest was concentrated in the soul.
claims.description: People rarely travel physically, and their restlessness becomes purely spiritual.

claims.quote: For Kuno had lately asked to be a father, and his request had been refused by the Committee.
claims.description: A central committee controls and can refuse individuals' requests to have children.

claims.quote: People never touched one another. The custom had become obsolete, owing to the Machine.
claims.description: People no longer touch one another physically, because machines mediate contact.

claims.quote: Night and day, wind and storm, tide and earthquake, impeded man no longer.
claims.description: Air travel is independent of weather, day and night, tides and earthquakes.

claims.quote: In it were instructions against every possible contingency.
claims.description: A single central book supplies instructions for every situation.

claims.quote: Few travelled in these days, for, thanks to the advance of science, the earth was exactly alike all over.
claims.description: Travel has declined because every place is identical under the machine.

claims.quote: You know that we have lost the sense of space.
claims.description: People lose their intuitive sense of distance because travel is mechanized.
